tools.command: npm run runtime:character-composer:validate && npm run runtime:character-composer:test
tools.notes: Validates fail-closed AssetRegistry binding, body/head/eyes/mouth/hair composition, shared anchors and body phases, independent per-part frame references, layer order, palette overrides and right/left mirroring. No visual asset bytes are generated.

Validates CSP, Android permissions/exported components/FileProvider scope, privacy retention, runtime dependency allowlist, external SDK absence and high-confidence secret patterns.

tools.command: npm run device:contract:test && npm run device:contract:validate
tools.notes: Validates the versioned device matrix, emulator-versus-physical truth boundary, lifecycle/offline evidence contract, separate development/release performance budgets and mandatory manual review. Live device execution remains explicit and never runs inside CI preflight.

Produces immutable per-run screenshots, UI trees, lifecycle/offline/save assertions, logcat, memory and gfx evidence. The configured development emulator cannot satisfy REL-002 physical-device or Release requirements.

Validates the release Schema, R8/resource shrinking, external-only signing boundary, dependency gates, Git/CI provenance, artifact contract, SBOM and reproducibility policy without claiming release eligibility.
